title: Non-proteolytic ubiquitination of HBx controls HBV replication.
authors: Sheng, Xiangpeng; Yang, Yi; Zhu, Min; Zhou, Linlin; Zhu, Fang; Zhu, Yuanfei; Dong, Siying; Kong, Hui; Wang, Honghua; Jiang, Ji; Wan, Mingyue; Feng, Mingyang; Deng, Qiang; Xu, Yumin; You, Qing; Hu, Ronggui
one_liner_zh: 该文研究TRIM21对HBV X蛋白的非蛋白水解泛素化调控病毒复制，属于病毒蛋白与宿主蛋白互作，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作、结合建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: * The expression level of TRIM21 in patients is negatively correlated with the replication and integration of HBV. * TRIM21 was found to trigger non-proteolytic ubiquitination of X protein of HBV. * This study proposes that the PRYSPRY and RING domains in TRIM21 dimer can form a docking conformation for HBx binding. * TRIM21-mediated HBx ubiquitination disrupts the DDB1 recruitment to HBx and stabilize Smc6.
abstract_zh: * 患者中TRIM21的表达水平与HBV的复制和整合呈负相关。* 研究发现TRIM21能触发HBV X蛋白的非蛋白水解性泛素化。* 本研究提出，TRIM21二聚体中的PRYSPRY和RING结构域可形成与HBx结合的对接构象。* TRIM21介导的HBx泛素化破坏了DDB1向HBx的招募，并稳定了Smc6。
